title: Webデザイン
subtitle: Web Design
educationalGoal: This course is for an educational goal of the Dept. of Management Systems to acquire "Information and Communication Technology ability". Students will: (1)acquire the basic ability to utilize IT including mark-up language and the Internet, (2)learn the fundamental theory of WWW (World Wide Web) site, (3)learn how to create, manage and operate web pages.
advice: To create, manage and operate a WWW site, the following 3 abilities are required: (1) The ability to understand the WWW site production process, (a) Planning a WWW site, (b) Design and implement a WWW site, (c) Manage and Operate a WWW site. (2) The ability to understand and apply HTML (Hyper-Text Mark-up Language) and CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) to produce a WWW site, (3) The ability to produce a web site that considers effective expression of information, ease of use, and availability to anyone. Students will acquire abilities 1 and 2 mainly through lectures and exercises in the first half of the course; they will acquire ability 3 in the second half of the course.
books: Text Book: A book that you can learn HTML & CSS and web design in one book (in Japanese), 2017/7/21, Gijutsu-Hyohron Co., Ltd.
requiredKnowledge: Prior knowledge is not required before taking this course, but you should learn the designated part of the textbook. According to students’ understanding degree, lectures and practicums progress may be changed.

activityGoals.body: Be able to set up your laptop computer and browse any WWW sites.
Be able to use text editor (Brackets) to design and implement Web pages using text and still images using HTML.
Be able to upload created files (contents) to a web server.
Be able to lay out web contents using CSS.
Be able to produce a web site that considers effective expression of information, ease of use, and availability
